text:
Liam (AE): Passing ArcadiaForms trial to Priya (CSM). Quick context: 30-seat pilot, expected pilot start 2026-05-04, Okta SAML SSO, likely dedicated pool request if throughput > 70 req/s. Customer flagged billing sensitivity — renewal could be at risk if unit cost isn't competitive.
Priya (CSM): Thanks Liam. Can you drop the customer runbook + any compliance notes here? I'll build a health timeline and kickoff agenda.
Liam (AE): Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/deals/arcadiaforms. Compliance: SOC2 required, retention 1 year for audit logs. They want a non-prod sandbox first.
Rina (Solutions): I'll own enablement + sample-workshop. Need two representative datasets and expected peak qps for training. Also ask for a list of internal users for RBAC mapping.
Liam (AE): Sending datasets link and list of admin emails now. Peak expected ~90 req/s on demo days, average ~25.
Noah (Support Eng): FYI: dedicated pool + private deploy requires KMS access and network egress rules. Also need their SAML certificates — the digest doesn't match what we have (mismatch).
Liam (AE): Put SAML cert here: <arcadia-saml.crt>. Customer used SHA256 fingerprint a1:b2:... - double-check.
Noah (Support Eng): Mismatch confirmed. Opening infra ticket RED-11788 to reconcile cert and request sandbox VPC. Marking this as a preflight blocker.
deploy-bot: Ticket RED-11788 created by Noah and assigned to eng-infra.
Priya (CSM): Noted. I'll add Preflight checklist items: SAML fingerprint, sandbox provisioning, SOC2 evidence, audit retention config. Scheduling kickoff Wed 10:00 PT.
Rina (Solutions): For the workshop I'll prepare a 45-min live demo + 30-min hands-on lab. Need API key (non-prod) and one replayable convo trace.
Liam (AE): API key placeholder and replay trace uploaded to shared doc. Also flagged that procurement is price-pushing; we should prepare Optimize recommendations early.
Priya (CSM): Plan: weekly enablement sync during pilot + cost review after week 2. I'll label account "renewal-watch" and ping growth if cost delta >15%.
Noah (Support Eng): Quick notes: if they insist on HSM/KMS, lead time ~6 weeks for procurement. If not, we can proceed with cloud KMS in ~3 days. Also need to whitelist their egress IPs: 34.210.12.0/24.
Liam (AE): Customer prefers cloud KMS but asked about HSM as an option later.
Rina (Solutions): I'll draft a one-pager showing expected token spend and three optimization levers: prefix caching, batching, and model variant (fast-vs-high-quality). Due Fri COB.
Priya (CSM): Owners & immediate next steps summary:
- Priya: kickoff invite, health timeline, weekly check-ins, label renewal-watch.
- Rina: enablement playbook + cost one-pager (Fri).
- Noah: RED-11788 infra ticket + SAML validation + sandbox VPC.
- Liam: confirm datasets uploaded, procurement conversations, customer comms.
Noah (Support Eng): RED-11788 created; added note about required IAM role and egress firewall rules. :white_check_mark:
Liam (AE): I'll confirm procurement preference and the procurement contact.
Priya (CSM): Any blockers?
Noah (Support Eng): SAML fingerprint mismatch and sandbox VPC pending. Those are our blockers until infra finishes the ticket.
Rina (Solutions): Waiting on replay trace and non-prod API key to finalize labs.
Priya (CSM): Kickoff scheduled Wed 10:00 PT. I'll post a short recap after the call and attach the health score. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
